contract: Append-only, and the same contract as the domain-relevance and match-behavior benchmarks. A case is added only by a human commit after adjudication; existing cases are never edited or removed. `expected` is the adjudicated target behavior. `observedAtFreeze` is what the shipped analyzer actually did when the case was written down, so a later reader can tell a fixed defect from a moved goalpost — a case whose two halves disagree is RED on purpose, and that is a legitimate state to commit. Every case names its origin: which flag, which reviewDisposition, who adjudicated it, and on what date. A case with no origin is unreviewable and is rejected at load.
scope: The retrieval, ranking, admission, and alignment layers — everything that happens AFTER the relevance gate has retained a passage. Gate decisions belong to tests/fixtures/domain-relevance-benchmark.json; passage boundaries belong to the intake fixtures; a defect isolated to one score component belongs in a focused unit regression in tests/lab-analyzer.test.mjs. md/FEEDBACK-PIPELINE.md is the routing table.

labels.mapped: Whether the passage must produce at least one credible match.
labels.primaryCanonId: The concept that must rank first among credible matches.
labels.presentCanonIds: Concepts that must appear somewhere in the credible matches. Weaker than primaryCanonId and usable alongside it.
labels.absentCanonIds: Concepts that must NOT appear in the credible matches. This is how a false positive is frozen without asserting what should have won instead.
labels.alignment: { canonId, label } — the stance a named match must carry. The label must come from the analyzer's own vocabulary.
labels.weakPresentCanonIds: Concepts that must be retained and visible as weak matches — below the credible threshold but not thrown away.

usage: Any subset of the labels may be asserted; a case states only what the adjudication actually decided. A case that asserts nothing is rejected, because it would pass forever without testing anything.

achievedAtCreation.note: Created empty, deliberately. The first case enters through md/FEEDBACK-PIPELINE.md, from a flag a human adjudicated — not from an author inventing sentences to fill a fixture. An empty benchmark that is structurally validated and wired into the suite is a functioning receptacle; a pre-populated one would be a set of guesses wearing evidence's clothes.
achievedAtCreation.firstInboxCase: ds-13 (domain-gate-error) routed on 2026-07-29 to the domain benchmark, where it already exists. It is recorded in md/FEEDBACK-PIPELINE.md as the worked example and produced no case here, which is the correct outcome for a gate defect.
